risks.note: Named by management in MD&A 'Risks and Concerns' as a risk the Company faces. Explosives manufacturing is a licensed, safety-critical process dependent on trained personnel, and the Company separately says more focus is made on training's and skill development of employees to further enhance safety.

Named in MD&A 'Risks and Concerns'. The Company says it has approached eminent experts to identify market risks and take pro-active actions, and in Perlite is diversifying into new areas of market to hold volumes.
risks.risk: Competition in the domestic and local markets

risks.note: Named in MD&A 'Risks and Concerns'. Manufacture of explosives is licence-dependent, so any tightening or lapse of licence and safety conditions is a structural constraint on operating the Vishwasnagar, Garamsur and other Units.
risks.risk: Stringent government regulations with respect to license and safety

risks.note: The Company states it has identified manufacturing risks at its various manufacturing locations and took appropriate measures to minimize the same; safety has been the primary focus on all production activities and processes have been strengthened from time to time to enhance safety.
risks.risk: Manufacturing risks across the various manufacturing locations

risks.note: The Company has approached eminent experts to identify market risks and take pro-active actions, indicating market exposure is treated as a live risk rather than an internal-only assessment. Business risk evaluation and management is described as an ongoing process, with the Board informed of risk assessment and minimization procedures.

The MD&A Industry Overview states the key raw material for manufacturing of explosives is Ammonium Nitrate, making the Explosives Division structurally exposed to that single input even though the Company does not itself label it a risk.
risks.risk: Dependence on Ammonium Nitrate as the key raw material

risks.note: Segment-wise performance attributes the volume of Bulk Explosives to the Company's continued presence in PSU's. The Outlook ties industry growth to emphasis on infrastructure growth and mining by the Govt., with growth drivers being mining, construction and infrastructure, and states Various Government Initiatives and Investment in manufacturing and infrastructure sectors will be crucial for the increasing demand — a policy- and capex-cycle-driven demand base.
risks.risk: Reliance on PSU customers for Bulk Explosives volumes, and on government infrastructure/mining spend for demand

risks.note: The Outlook states that during the Financial Year 2025-26 the Company's focus is majorly into exports and that the New plant commissioned in March 2026 is expected to stabilise, with these steps said to ensure continued growth — so near-term growth rests on that ramp and on export demand. The Board separately states there is no risk identified which in its opinion may threaten the existence of the Company.
risks.risk: Stabilisation of the newly commissioned plant alongside an export-led focus
